title: Informatica MDM Engineer
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Department:** Data Engineering

**About Simform:**

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specialising in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform has strong capabilities across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 6 countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform is well-recognised as one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

**Role Overview :**

We are looking for an experienced **Informatica MDM Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using the Informatica platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Informatica MDM Hub, Data Director (IDD), PowerCenter, and Data Quality (IDQ), with hands-on experience in implementing Match & Merge rules, Data Stewardship, and integrating MDM solutions with enterprise applications. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-quality data management solutions that support business and data governance initiatives.

**Key Responsibility:**

* Design, develop, and implement enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions using Informatica MDM.
* Configure and manage Informatica MDM Hub, Data Director (IDD), and Match & Merge rules.
* Develop and maintain ETL workflows using Informatica PowerCenter and Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) where applicable.
* Implement and manage data quality solutions using Informatica Data Quality (IDQ).
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and data stewards to define and implement data governance and stewardship processes.
* Integrate Informatica MDM solutions with enterprise applications using REST/SOAP APIs, XML, and JSON.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects on Oracle and SQL Server.
* Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance existing MDM and ETL solutions to improve performance and scalability.
* Work closely with architects, developers, and business teams to deliver high-quality data integration and master data solutions.
* Prepare technical documentation, design specifications, and deployment artifacts.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, production support, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5–10+ years of experience working with Informatica technologies.
* Strong expertise in Informatica MDM Hub and Informatica Data Director (IDD).
* Hands-on experience with Informatica PowerCenter.
* Experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ).
* Experience implementing Match & Merge rules and Data Stewardship processes.
* Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Governance concepts.
* Experience in ETL design and development.
* Strong SQL skills with Oracle and/or SQL Server databases.
* Experience integrating MDM solutions with enterprise applications.
* Working knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, XML, and JSON.
* Experience with Unix/Linux scripting.
* Experience with Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) is preferred.
* Knowledge of Java is an added advantage.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Why Join Us:**

* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat-hierarchical, friendly, engineering-oriented, and growth-focused culture.
* Well-balanced learning and growth opportunities.
* Free health insurance.
* Office facilities with a game zone, in-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
* Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
* Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options.

description:
Full Time

Ahmedabad

As an AWS Solution Architect, your primary responsibility will be to design and deploy secure, scalable, and highly available AWS cloud-based solutions for clients. You will work closely with clients, understanding their business requirements, and architecting cost-effective and efficient solutions that align with their goals. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, engineers, and project managers, to ensure successful implementation and delivery of AWS solutions.

**Experience:** 4+ Years

* Design and architect AWS cloud-based solutions that meet client requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
* Collaborate with clients to understand their business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solution designs.
* Assess existing infrastructure and systems, identify opportunities for migration or adoption of AWS services, and create migration plans.
* Develop highly available and fault-tolerant architecture patterns using AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others.
* Create technical documentation including solution architecture diagrams, design documents, and deployment guides.

**Requirements:**

* Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and provisioning tools such as AWS Cloud Formation, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Proficient in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
